full_judgment: 9. It so transpired that Begum Ummat Rasool took no steps to complete the transfer of the plot even after the expiry of the thirty-day period specified in the judgment and decree dated 27-5-1974. Accordingly, as per the dispensation in the said judgment Mr Haque deposited Taka 95,000 in the First Court of Sub-ordinate Judge, Dhaka by way of Government Challan No.3734 dated 18-11-1974. Thereafter, Mr Haque filed Title Execution Case No. 42 of 1974 before the said Court for having the sale deed executed and registered through Court further to which the Court executed Sale Deed No. 395 dated 28-12-1974 as was registered before the Office of District Registrar, Dhaka for and on behalf of Begum Ummat Rasool, thereby, effectively transferring the plot to Mr Haque. Mr Haque's application to RAJUK's predecessor entity DIT followed thereafter for mutating his name with regard to the plot in the record of rights. Even though Mr Haque enclosed the certified copy of the judgment, the registered Sale Deed dated 28-12-1974 and other relevant documents, DIT vide its Memo No. DIT/EO/1088 dated 8-3-1977 declined to mutate his name citing the reason that DIT was not made a party in Title Suit No. 85 of 1972. In the meantime, Mr Haque got his name mutated with all other departments like the City Corporation, various utility service-providers, the Settlement Department etc. in connection with the plot. He also got his name mutated with the Gulshan Revenue Office and obtained Mutation Khatian dated 8-5-1976. It is asserted that the Gulshan Revenue Office also issued a Field Survey Khatian on 30-5-1999 in Mr Haque's favour in connection with the said plot.
